name: Jergosh the Invoker
summary: Deep beneath Orgrimmar, Jergosh the Invoker plots against the Horde. He leads Searing Blade cultists in Ragefire Chasm and practices demonic arts while Thrall guides the orcs toward honor and shamanism.

sections.title: A Cult Beneath the City
sections.body: Jergosh gathers the Searing Blade beneath Orgrimmar. While Thrall leads the orcs toward honor and shamanism, Jergosh turns to demonic power. He hides in Ragefire Chasm, where he draws followers into a sect aligned with the remnants of the Shadow Council. From below the Horde capital, the cult works against the path the new Horde has chosen.

sections.title: Demonic Ambitions
sections.body: Jergosh's work in Ragefire Chasm draws Thrall's direct scrutiny. Dark rituals and dangerous schemes have grown bold enough to attract the Warchief's attention. Within Durotar, Jergosh keeps alive the dark pacts the Horde fought to leave behind.

faq.answer: Jergosh the Invoker leads the Searing Blade cultists in Ragefire Chasm. He rejects Thrall's honorable path and embraces demonic sorcery.

faq.q: Why is Jergosh hiding in Ragefire Chasm?
faq.answer: Jergosh hides in Ragefire Chasm beneath Orgrimmar, where the Searing Blade can practice dark magic and conspire against the Horde.

faq.q: What faction does Jergosh belong to?
faq.answer: Jergosh leads the Searing Blade, a cult linked to the Shadow Council and devoted to demonic interests like the Burning Legion.

faq.q: Does Thrall know Jergosh is beneath Orgrimmar?
faq.answer: Yes. Jergosh's plots grew dangerous enough to reach Thrall, who sent trusted adventurers into Ragefire Chasm to stop the cultists.

faq.q: Why does Jergosh practice fel magic instead of shamanism?
faq.answer: Jergosh rejects shamanistic harmony and turns to demonic sorcery, seeking the power of the Burning Legion and the dark arts.

angles.text: As an orc, you can see in Jergosh the old Horde's lingering pull toward demonic blood and sorcery, which Thrall seeks to purge from orcish culture.
As a warlock, you face a powerful practitioner of the demonic arts whose schemes threaten the Horde.
A Shadow Council cell beneath the chieftain's throne room is a security threat the Horde cannot ignore.
